comment: The machine-readable marker on a delivered reply when a runner turn fails (#3401). The worker prefixes the channel reply. The factory status comment carries the same class on its own line. The CLI refuses to grade a reply that starts with the marker as a successful task reply. Python and Rust cannot share the literal, so it is frozen here. An unknown top-level key is rejected. identity_refused_class is the class the worker writes on the cluster message relay when it refuses a turn for lack of an HTTP identity (#5518); the CLI eval stops on it. plain_replies are the sentences a person sees in place of the marked record on every route except the cluster message relay (#5984); a consumer that sees only the delivered channel text, the local Slack stub, counts a reply that is exactly one of them as a failed turn of class unclassified.
